items.text: New York banned companion chatbots from posing as human or claiming a friendship or romance with children. The attorney general can sue for up to $25,000 per violation.
Anthropic study: 50 analysts went with their AI agent's randomly assigned lean 86% of the time. 77% reused its arguments; 15% credited it.
Purdue's political deepfakes database has logged 482 posts this midterm cycle; Donald Trump appears in 279 of them.
The flaw under most websites, day 8: still no victim named. Three of the 25 systems Dream says were rooted sat in a US government-affiliated network. The federal fix deadline is tomorrow, Oct 29.
